name: healthshield
description: HealthShield - Privacy-Preserving Healthcare Records & Zero-Knowledge Insurance Claims Platform

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "NODE,CONTRACTS,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow,blue,magenta,green" "npm --prefix contracts run node" "npm --prefix contracts run deploy:local" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:backend
